display_long_description:
Boxten VR Boxing — throw real punches, take real hits

Step into the arena, raise your fists, and fight with your whole body. No button combos, no cutscenes — just you, your reach, and a fighter across the ring who reads every opening you leave.

15 FIGHTERS, 15 FIGHTING STYLES
From cyber ninjas to flame-wielding champions, every opponent brings a different rhythm, reach, and set of combos. Learn how each one moves before you learn how to beat them.

5 VR ARENAS
Trade blows on neon city rooftops, inside ancient battle temples, and across arenas built to put you in the middle of the action.

5 DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, and Extreme. As you climb, opponents react faster, block smarter, and open up new attack patterns. Extreme punishes every lazy guard.

REAL MELEE COMBAT
Duck under a hook. Slip a jab. Counter while they're still recovering. Your actual movement is your defense — dodging is something you do, not something you press.

BUILT FOR META QUEST
Room-scale VR combat designed to keep you moving. Comfort rating: [match your submission form exactly].

Compatible with Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro.

Step in. Lock eyes. Raise your fists.
